onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.completeHint: You have tried the main parts of Gostman. The tutorial goes further with chaining requests, scripts and running your checks in CI.

send.title: Send a request
send.hint: Send a sample request to a public echo service and read the response.

save.title: Save it to your collection
save.hint: Saved requests appear in the sidebar and stay on this device.

variable.title: Add a variable
variable.hint: Define baseUrl once in an environment, then write {{example}} wherever you need it.

check.title: Add a check
check.hint: Write an assertion such as res.status equals 200, or use Add checks from this response in the Checks tab. Then save the request, and each response shows a pass or a fail.

run.title: Run your requests together
run.hint: The runner sends every saved request in order and reports which checks passed.
